title: Meadowbrook school campus
goal: Show campus buildings, parking, play space, and fire access.

rubric.must: Administration, Primary Building, Gymnasium, and Middle School are visibly separate labelled footprints.
Staff Parking and Play Fields are visibly labelled areas.
A continuous labelled fire access route visibly serves the academic buildings.
School Drive and the main entry are visibly connected to the campus circulation.
Hydrant, north arrow, scale, and legend are visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the siteplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows all four buildings as separate, labelled footprints; labelled staff parking and play fields; a continuous, labelled fire access route around the academic buildings; and School Drive connected to the campus circulation and main entry. The hydrant, north arrow, scale, and legend are visible. Labels are readable, with no material overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: Administration, Primary Building, Gymnasium, and Middle School appear as separate labelled footprints.
Staff Parking and Play Fields are visibly labelled areas.
The labelled Fire Access Route forms a continuous route beside the academic buildings.
School Drive connects to the campus circulation; the marked Main entry connects the drive to the campus.
The hydrant, north arrow, graphic scale, and legend are visible.
